Method of Attack: Opening a large number of SMB connections to exhaust RAM and crash the target system
Denial of Service (DoS) attack via SMB protocol by exhausting resources
Impacted Systems: All versions of Windows since Windows 2000
All three SMB protocol versions (SMBv1, SMBv2, SMBv3)
Attack Vector: Remote unauthenticated connections via SMB protocol (port 445)
Indicators of Compromise: Proof-of-concept code released by Hector Martin
